questions.question: Where is the largest open pit copper mine in the world?
questions.questionHtml: Where is the largest open pit copper mine in the world?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Chile.

Key Points

  • Chuquicamata, mining and smelting center, northern Chile is the largest open-pit copper mine in the world by volume and the second deepest open-pit mine in the world at 850 meters.
  • It lies near Calama at 9,350 feet (2,850 meters) above sea level.
  • Large-scale operations started in 1915.

 

Important Points

  • The Carajas mine is the largest iron ore mine in the world.
    • It is located in the state of Para in the Carajas mountains of northern Brazil. 
  • Kimberley, the city is a diamond-mining centre, and capital of Northern Cape province, South Africa.
  • Russia has the largest and richest resource for Dimond.
    • They are the largest producer and exporter of crude diamonds.

questions.question: Where was country's first jute mill establish in 1917 ?
questions.questionHtml: Where was country's first jute mill establish in 1917 ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Calcutta.

Key Points

  • Jute is also considered as the gold fibre because it is the cheapest natural fibre.

Additional Information

  • The first textile mill was established in Bombay in 1853 by Cowasjee Nanobhoy Davor as well as his associates.

questions.question: Which industry is of the oldest industry in the world?
questions.questionHtml: Which industry is of the oldest industry in the world?
questions.solution: The cotton textile industry is one of the oldest industries in the world. Today India, China, Japan and the USA are important producers of cotton textiles. The first successful mechanized textile mill in India was established in Mumbai in 1854. The first textile mill in the country was established at Fort Gloster near Kolkata in 1818 but it closed down after some time.

questions.question: Haridwar is famous for
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Heavy Electrical Industry.

  • Haridwar, meaning 'Gateway to God, is one of the seven holiest cities (Sapt Puris) in India that is located on the banks of the holy Ganga River in the state of Uttarakhand. 
  • The ancient city is home to several temples, ashrams, ghats and numerous other revered sites for Hindu pilgrims.​

Important Points

  • BHEL, Haridwar has two manufacturing plants, Heavy Electricals Equipment Plant (HEEP) and Central Foundry Forge Plant (CFFP). It also has a Pollution Control Research Institute, PCRI.
  • The Heavy Electricals Equipment Plant is one of the major manufacturing units of BHEL.​​

Hence, The correct answer is Heavy Electrical Industry.

questions.question: Which of the following countries has the maximum production of milk per cow?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following countries has the maximum production of milk per cow?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Denmark.

Key Points

  • The Danish dairy industry consists of the international dairy group Arla Foods and 30 smaller dairy companies, together with processing 4.7 billion kg of milk from a total of 61 production plants in Denmark.
  • The value of all Danish dairy exports totals EUR 1.8 billion annually.
  • In 2010, approx. 4,100 dairy farmers each had an average of 127 cows and a milk quota of 1,142 tonnes.
  • This places the Danish dairy farmers among the largest and most modern in Europe. More than half the cows live in new loose-housing systems.
  • Exports of dairy products, in particular cheese, preserved milk products and butter, accounting for more than 20 per cent of all Danish agricultural exports.
  • The domestic market is, to a large extent, a market for domestic dairy production, although imported cheese and yoghurt now account for approx. 25 per cent and 20 per cent, respectively, of total domestic consumption.
  • Milk Production in India (Million tonnes) in 2018- 187.96.
  • Denmark is basically the ideal country for dairy production. The climate and soil provide the most favourable conditions for dairy cattle farming.
